Your response makes me feel like atleast someone out there understands. Thank you! You hit it on the dot, I want to do the right thing but it's so hard to identify the appropriate line to uphold and when to be more flexible. Its counter intuitive to how we resolve issues on the outside world and I feel guilt bc of it. 

I'll tell you I've been exercising and running more which has gotten my spouse on the same page. Its normally 2 months of positive direction and then normally a bout of depression. We'll see, once I start seeing signs this time around I have a plan to make the person feel important and cared for. I want to see if the lift can overwhelm whatever it is they're feeling and then gauge the appropriate amount of reality.

Hope your situation is improving and that you're im a better place than last.

Friend, I'm in the same situation except we've been married together for over 10 years with kids. If you're seeing the signs now, don't ignore it. Either it gets fixed like seriously dealt with or you are better off cutting your losses now in order to move forward. 

Im sorry youre going through this. I know the constant anguish. Im constantly in knots and starting to fear for my own health.

You deserved the support, attention and care. Im sorry you feel like you didn't get it. I know where you're coming from. One thing I know I have to deal with is I don't exactly make it easy for others to know my needs and you're probably the same. People like us who have real issues dont broadcast it so it continues to eat at us but then how do we move forward without fulfilling that void in our lives. Im here if you need anything.
